text:
ana: Observed a sudden memory bump for embeddings in eu-west1 around 22:05 UTC, errors up ~4%. suspect kvcache churn. proposing a small hotfix + phased shift to eu-west2 in the 22:30-23:00 UTC window.
deploy-bot: Deploy request DR-2040-101 created. image: registry.redwood/internal/embeddings:v3.4.1-hotfix. plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%.
mike: prefer phased shift with pinned fallback to v3.4.0 for instant rollback. what's expected latency in eu-west2?
ana: (typo) ana: lab runs in eu-west2 show mem churn reduced ~32%, p95 similar. will pin v3.4.0.
ops-bot: noted rollback image v3.4.0; please provide explicit rollback triggers.
ana: rollback triggers: immediate rollback if errors >1% OR p95 increases >180ms sustained 3m OR any OOMs.
ravi: Infra lead expedited approval needed. I'll ping @ravi for signoff.
ravi: ravi: approved via DM. cadence: 5% for 5m, 25% for 8m, ramp to 100% if stable. Post release note after cutoff.
mike: ops runbook snippet: ```
# start eu-west2 canary
deployctl rollout --cluster eu-west2 --svc embeddings --image v3.4.1-hotfix --percent 5 --note "DR-2040-101"
# rollback
deployctl rollback --cluster eu-west2 --svc embeddings --image v3.4.0
```
ops-bot: Temporary alert ALRT-9001 created for p95>180ms OR errors>1%. escalation: oncall -> infra-lead. Scheduled DR-2040-101 at 22:30 UTC. Operators: ana, mike.
releasebot: Release note attached: "Embeddings v3.4.1-hotfix — kvcache stabilization" https://console.redwood/releases/DR-2040-101
ana: (ana): all set. will update thread with final status after the monitoring hold.
